# Prism

Prism is a cross-platform theme with five light and five dark color schemes, three layout styles and several accent presets alongside custom color support. Highlights come in four styles with independent text color, and the visual options are adjusted through the Style Settings plugin.

![Prism screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/damiankorcz/Prism-Theme/HEAD/assets/screenshots/Community%20Themes%20Screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Prism"
    author: "damiankorcz"
    repo:   "damiankorcz/Prism-Theme"
    slug:   "prism"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/prism"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/damiankorcz/Prism-Theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/damiankorcz/Prism-Theme/HEAD/assets/screenshots/Community%20Themes%20Screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a cross-platform Obsidian theme with five light and five dark color schemes, three layout styles, and multiple accent presets plus custom color support. Customize highlights with four styles and independent text color, and adjust visual options via the Style Settings plugin."
}
```
